title: Design: long and special tier names on Sales by Tier rows
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 1 S1-R11 S1-R6 Reports Story 3 S3-R3),SV-11694 (Story 2 S2-R3)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35, so the stress tiers have a matrix to price from.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a long name with spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment Fleet Pricing Tier).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a long name with no spaces of exactly 50 characters (for example NorthernAlbertaHeavyEquipmentFleetPricingTierPlanX).
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name with the characters & " ' < > in it (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Tier>).
  • Have three new customers for this test, customers A, B and C, put on tiers A, B and C for work orders, each with an invoiced work order today with a part in category A, so each tier has a row.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customers A, B and C in the Customer filter.
  3. Open the Priced By filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's, tier B's and tier C's rows each show their name inside their own row.
  • No name covers the next row or the Parts Cost column.
  • Parts Margin % and % of Total stay fully visible at the right.
  • Every column stays visible and the page does not scroll sideways.
  • Tier C's name shows character for character, & " ' < > included.

Step 3:

  • Each long name in the list wraps or is shortened with "..." inside its own row, never past the list's edge.
  • Every checkbox stays visible.
